text:
99BrightMinds is seeking a Salesforce QA / Testing Analyst to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of Salesforce solutions across multiple cloud platforms. The ideal candidate will have experience in both manual and automated testing, with a strong understanding of Salesforce ecosystems and Agile delivery practices.

 Responsibilities

• Design, execute, and maintain comprehensive manual and automated test strategies.

• Develop and manage test cases, test plans, and test scripts for Salesforce applications.

• Test complex user journeys across multiple Salesforce modules and business processes.

• Perform integration, end-to-end, functional, regression, and user acceptance testing.

• Identify, document, and track defects, working closely with development teams to ensure timely resolution.

• Validate integrations between Salesforce and external systems.

• Participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure quality throughout the development lifecycle.

 Requirements

• 3+ years of experience in software quality assurance and testing.

• Hands-on experience with one or more Salesforce products, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, or Marketing Cloud.

• Experience in both manual and automated testing methodologies.

• Strong understanding of software testing principles, defect management, and test lifecycle processes.

• Experience testing integrated enterprise applications and complex business workflows.

• Experience working in Agile environments, including Scrum and Scaled Agile frameworks.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

• Must be based in Jordan, Egypt, or India.

 Preferred Qualifications

• Salesforce certifications or testing-related certifications are a plus.

• Experience with test automation tools and frameworks.

• Experience using defect tracking and test management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.

• Familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps practices.
